summary: The Trump administration has reportedly alerted Gulf states to prepare for potential strikes on Iran as early as November 4, while Israeli forces conduct ongoing operations in southern Lebanon and Gaza. Iranian military activity includes fighter jets over Khuzestan, helicopters over Fars, and a claimed UAV attack on a fishing boat near Qeshm Island. The Kurdistan Region recorded reduced but persistent drone and missile strikes in October, totaling over 1,000 since February.
key_points: Trump administration informed Gulf states to prepare for short, intense strikes on Iran possibly starting November 4, per Arab officials. (Source: @yediotnews25/137054)

RC-135W Rivet Joint aircraft transiting from CONUS to RAF Mildenhall then Chania, indicating heightened surveillance over Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11795)

points: The Trump administration has reportedly informed Gulf states to prepare for a short, intense round of strikes against Iran possibly beginning November 4, the day after U.S. midterm elections, based on three Arab officials cited by MSNOW. (Source: @yediotnews25/137054)

Mojtaba Khamenei's official channel announced that important strategic directives from the Supreme Leader would be released following his meeting with senior armed forces commanders. (Source: @shin_persian/11800)
IRGC-affiliated Fars News Agency claimed a UAV attack on a fishing boat injured two fishermen 14 nautical miles south of Qeshm Island in Hormozgan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/11798)

Fighter-jet activity was observed over Dezful in Khuzestan Province at 12:20 local time (0850Z), and helicopter activity was recorded over Shiraz in Fars Province at 1315Z (16:45 Tehran time). (Source: @shin_persian/11796, @shin_persian/11804)
An explosion heard near Mount Sofeh in Isfahan was presumed to be unexploded ordnance disposal. (Source: @shin_persian/11792)

A U.S. Air Force RC-135W Rivet Joint (callsign OLIVE32, tail 62-4132) arrived from CONUS to RAF Mildenhall and was expected to proceed to Chania, Crete, indicating enhanced SIGINT collection over Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11795)
A Comoros-flagged container ship 'Jasmin' (IMO 9179919), reportedly under Iranian operation, was targeted and disabled by U.S. forces according to the cameraperson. (Source: @shin_persian/11801)

Canada's CSIS stated it disrupted potentially lethal threats in Canada involving Iranian intelligence or proxies in multiple cases and expects such activity to continue. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9222)
Senator Marco Rubio stated Trump has not made a decision on potential Iran strikes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9226)
The IDF conducted strikes in southern Lebanon, with documentation of the strike wave circulated. (Source: @yediotnews25/137057, @yediotnews25/137064)
The IDF struck in Khan Younis, Gaza, with Palestinians reporting one fatality from the attack. (Source: @yediotnews25/137059)
An Israeli loitering munition drone exploded on the roof of a structure in the village of Mifdon. (Source: @yediotnews25/137058)

The IDF reported unexploded ordnance discovered in the Ramim Ridge area in northern Israel; military police cordoned the area and EOD teams are neutralizing the munitions; the zone was declared a closed military area. (Source: @yediotnews25/137063)
The IDF conducted strikes in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, with Palestinian sources reporting one person killed. (Source: @yediotnews25/137059)
Fighter jets were tracked over southern Lebanon via live map by RedLinkLeb. (Source: @redlinkleb/50839, @redlinkleb/50814, @redlinkleb/50833)
Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi Nahla, southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/50838)
A drone strike targeted Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/50819)
A large explosion was reported between the towns of Beit Yahoun and Barishit, heard across the south. (Source: @redlinkleb/50856)
RedLinkLeb issued an alert denying reports of an Israeli military vehicle near the mosque on the Tuline–Barq Qalaway road. (Source: @redlinkleb/50831)
An Israeli loitering munition drone exploded on a rooftop in the village of Mifdon. (Source: @yediotnews25/137058)
Documentation of the wave of Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon was published. (Source: @yediotnews25/137064)

sections.threat_assessment: The reported U.S. notification to Gulf states of potential strikes on Iran by November 4 signals a critical escalation window. Concurrent Iranian military activity — fighter jets over Khuzestan, helicopters over Fars, and a claimed UAV attack near Qeshm — suggests heightened readiness. The RC-135W deployment to the Eastern Mediterranean indicates intensified U.S. SIGINT collection. Israel's simultaneous operations in Lebanon (Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Wadi Nahla, Mifdon) and Gaza (Khan Younis) reflect a multi-front posture. The targeting of an Iranian-operated vessel suggests maritime interdiction is active. These developments collectively raise the probability of direct U.S.-Iran kinetic action within weeks.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are reportedly on alert for imminent U.S. strikes on Iran, per Arab officials. The Kurdistan Region's strike tally — over 1,000 since February — demonstrates sustained Iranian pressure on Iraqi territory. Canada's CSIS disclosure of disrupted Iranian proxy threats indicates extraterritorial Iranian operations are expanding. Lebanon's RedLinkLeb network documents daily Israeli air and artillery activity across the south, while denying specific Israeli ground presence rumors. The UN's demand for investigation into a staffer's death in Houthi detention highlights Yemen's linkage to the broader regional confrontation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Mojtaba Khamenei's announcement of impending Supreme Leader directives after meeting senior commanders suggests imminent Iranian strategic decisions. The RC-135W transit via Mildenhall to Chania positions a premier SIGINT asset for monitoring Iranian missile tests, air defense activity, and command communications. The 'Jasmin' container ship disablement, if confirmed, marks a kinetic U.S. action against Iranian maritime logistics. The reduction in Kurdistan Region strikes from September to October may indicate Iranian resource reallocation or weather factors. CSIS's public attribution to Iranian intelligence is a rare explicit Western acknowledgment of proxy threat activity on NATO soil.
